title: Grant web CI token access to private GHCR runner
rationale: GitHub container jobs pull private GHCR images before job steps run, so the consumer workflow must declare top-level packages: read alongside contents: read. Keep the producer handoff image pinned to the immutable digest and use no secrets.

outcomes.notes: Current web consumer workflow still requests packages: read and uses an immutable runner digest; the current digest differs from this historical record and is captured separately in the workflow.
outcomes.test_results: Current workflow review; npm run build succeeded; web tests 43/43.

title: Consume verified rootless runner digest in web CI
rationale: The web contract now uses the published senshac-runner digest from workflow 36323875728, authenticates private GHCR with packages: read and GITHUB_TOKEN, overrides the image user to UID/GID 1001:122 for hosted workspace write access, and derives PLAYWRIGHT_CHROMIUM_PATH from the image's PATH-provided Chromium.
